decisions.decision: Website: the committee is established and will meet with the top three website hosting vendors; Ernie will provide a link for the committee to review.
decisions.quote: ernie will provide a link for the committee to review, which provides service to a florida website, which he finds easy to navigate.

decisions.decision: Goal #4: items 5 and 6 (Personnel Training for Effective Customer Service; Employee Retreat/Seminar for Team Building) to be removed from the goal.
decisions.quote: items 5 & 6; consider personnel training for effective customer service and consider & recommend employee retreat/seminar for team building to be removed from goal #4.

decisions.decision: Goal #4: Kerry will provide the board with a list of employees who by law may have a contract; the rest will move under the Salary Administration Plan.
decisions.quote: kerry will provide the board with a list of employees who by law are allowed to have a contract

decisions.decision: Goal #3: quarterly status of ongoing legal issues to be ongoing rather than a goal; the citizen newsletter is to be looked at bi-annually.
decisions.quote: provide quarterly status of all ongoing legal issues should be ongoing and not

decisions.decision: Goal #4: Kerry will check with labor counsel on the legality of department head evaluations of employees, and will work with union negotiations to incorporate evaluation language into contracts.
decisions.quote: kerry will check with labor counsel as to the legality, particularly if the evaluation doesn't have an impact on their compensation.

decisions.decision: Goal #2: the board expects the Town Manager to hold conversations and document recommendations on changing processes; the board wants department metrics across all departments, including smaller ones such as the Planning Board.
decisions.quote: would expect that the manager have conversations and document the recommendations on changing processes

decisions.decision: PAYT: the board would like to pursue solar-powered trash compactors and recycle containers, with Kerry to ask Emerald Place to purchase a couple.
decisions.quote: board would like to pursue this.

decisions.decision: Town Hall renovation: Kerry will take the draft plan back to Pat Slattery to see whether it will work and, if so, price the project.
decisions.quote: kerry still needs to take this back to pat slattery to see if it's going to work and if so, pricing the project out.

decisions.decision: Warrant W/P 10 (6/30/10): Kerry will look into the Sani-tank invoice questions raised by Paula and respond to the board.
decisions.quote: kerry will look into this and respond to the board.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board reviewed and signed warrant W/P 10 dated 6/30/10 at the stated total.
Paula questioned an invoice for a piping project in Whalom and why the town is paying for any component tied to Emerald Place; Kerry will look into it.
budget_items.quote: paula questioned an invoice (sani-tank) for piping project in whalom

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Vendors were reportedly charging about $60 a month three years ago and now charge less; the actual fee and participation count are not yet known.
budget_items.quote: three years ago vendors were charging about $60/month and now we're hearing that they're charging less per month

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kerry is not ready to propose a fee increase; the Waste Management contract expires June 2011.
budget_items.quote: currently kerry is not ready to propose to raise the fees, noted that the contract expires june 2011

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The three website hosting vendors were discussed; the minutes say their prices are similar, with no figures printed.
budget_items.quote: virtual town hall and egov are the two that are widely used within massachusetts and prices are similar.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The renovation is not yet priced; carpeting may be donated and the plumbing and electrical inspectors would do the work on an hourly basis.
budget_items.quote: have a person willing to donate carpeting, our plumbing and electrical inspector's would be doing the work on an hourly basis.
